purpose: Human annotation taxonomy for JobRadar Phase 4. Labels are gold labels only after a human reviewer completes them.

role_families.name: Data Scientist & Advanced Analytics
role_families.description: Uses statistics, experimentation, forecasting, or advanced analytical methods to answer business or research questions.

role_families.name: Machine Learning & AI Engineer
role_families.description: Builds, deploys, evaluates, or operates machine-learning, AI, computer-vision, NLP, LLM, or generative-AI systems.

role_families.name: Data Engineer & Big Data Platform
role_families.description: Builds data pipelines, warehouses, ETL/ELT workflows, streaming systems, or data-platform infrastructure.

role_families.name: Data Analyst & Business Intelligence
role_families.description: Produces reports, dashboards, SQL analysis, metrics, and business insights without primary responsibility for advanced modeling.

role_families.name: Backend & Core Software Engineering
role_families.description: Builds APIs, services, application logic, databases, integrations, or general software systems.

role_families.name: Frontend & Full Stack Engineering
role_families.description: Builds user interfaces, web or mobile clients, or end-to-end applications with a meaningful frontend responsibility.

role_families.name: Cloud, DevOps & SRE
role_families.description: Operates cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, reliability, observability, deployment, security automation, or platform operations.

role_families.name: QA & Automation Testing
role_families.description: Validates software quality through manual testing, test automation, performance testing, or quality engineering.

role_families.name: Product & Technical Project Management
role_families.description: Owns product direction, requirements, delivery coordination, project planning, or technical program management.

role_families.name: Non-Tech / Corporate & Operations
role_families.description: Covers HR, sales, finance, support, administration, recruiting, legal, healthcare operations, and other non-technical work.

role_families.name: Other / Unclassified
role_families.description: Use only when the available title and description do not support one of the other role families.

Data Analyst.note: The current taxonomy intentionally combines analyst and BI work.

Generative AI Engineer.note: A future specialization rule can identify generative-AI work within this broader family; Stage 1 does not create a separate gold label.

Business Intelligence.note: The current taxonomy intentionally combines BI and analyst work.
